data.title: Approval of basic income support (Bewilligung von Leistungen zur Sicherung des Lebensunterhalts)
data.summary: The Jobcenter Musterhavel-Fläming approved monthly basic income support (SGB II) of €1,233.96 for Doreen Musterlitz and her household for the period 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027. Because of a planned move on 1 August 2026, she must submit the signed new rental contract and proof of the deposit by 14 July 2026, otherwise only the previous housing costs will continue to be paid.
data.explanation: This is a benefit decision (Bescheid) from your local Jobcenter, granting you and your son monthly financial support. Because you reported an upcoming move, you must send the signed rental contract and deposit proof by the stated deadline so your new, higher housing costs can be taken into account from August; otherwise the Jobcenter will keep paying only your old rent amount. If you disagree with any part of this decision (e.g. the calculated amounts), you may file a written objection (Widerspruch); the app shows the deadline for this. If you miss it, the decision becomes final.
